authority: AGENTS.md: Migration delivery strategy — user clarification 2026-10-30
delivery_baseline: Preserve the current original employee UI; migrate backend/auth/client/hooks/DTO/status only. Native workbench is verification/reference.

priority.title: 原首页模板/现有Agent → 完整编辑保存/另存 → 原Agent试跑与执行记录
priority.reason: Reuses existing Home/AgentCatalog/SpecEditorCard/useHome/useAgentRun interactions and existing PG Agent CRUD/run domains, while exercising authentication, owner isolation, DTOs, CAS, persistence and Worker projections. It avoids making the separate pilot page a delivery dependency.

steps.work: Mount the current /login/AuthGate/session adapter with existing same-origin PG Cookie authentication; preserve original redirect and outage behavior.
Freeze Home Agent list/detail/full-save/provenance/delete ABI. Existing POST/PATCH remain source reusable; define only genuinely missing list/provenance/delete behavior and owner/audit semantics.

Adapt Home AgentCatalog and useHome beneath the current components: UUID, complete spec save, real revision, item/items response, pagination/search, metadata and draft conflict handling. Existing handleLoadTemplate at useHome:560 supplies a draft without inventing a new editor.

Keep original AgentRun page. Bind the saved Agent revision and chosen current verified model/resources; distinguish prepare-only and actual Agent execution. Map existing controlled run/steps/approval/input/control/result APIs to the original panels.

Add and run later a genuine isolated original-page PG E2E: /login -> / -> edit/save/copy -> refresh -> /agent-run -> actual bounded authorized flow -> /run-detail. Include cross-owner denial, CAS conflict, outage,401/logout and lost-ACK recovery. No browser/SQL/Worker/provider execution is performed by this mapping task.

priority.acceptance_boundary: A prepare-only submission can prove the first API/queue stage only. Full trial success requires the original page to display genuinely executed Worker results, with any provider activity in a separately authorized isolated fixture. Existing PG pilot tests or numbers do not close this slice.
